headline: Personnel and attacking activity

paragraphs.text: Northbridge declared a switch from 4-3-3 to 4-2-3-1 at 45′; this is an authored formation change and its on-pitch effect is not observed here. Comparison windows provided are 40′–45′ (before) and 45′–50′ (after).

In the supplied interval Northbridge produced more attempts: 2 attempts versus 0 attempts for the opponent. No attempts were recorded as saved, and the facts note that shot counts alone do not establish chance quality or overall dominance.

Statistically, Northbridge recorded 2 shots in 40′–45′ and 0 in 45′–50′, while completed passes rose from 18 to 22 across those same windows. Morgan received a yellow card; the data note we would need comparable defensive actions to claim the booking changed behavior.

limitations: Formation effects, off-ball movement and chance quality cannot be inferred from the sparse events provided.

This is a simplified synthetic simulator with authored formation inputs and no external match validation; alternative explanations (opponent actions, game state, random variation) are not resolved by these facts.
